name: Cargo Compass
summary: Lists the nearest suppliers and consumers for each cargo, and shows a single flow arrow on the map.
description:
(Formerly Closest Consumer.) Click any industry or warehouse, and Cargo Compass adds a card to its window that shows where each cargo can come from and where it can go.

- Suppliers: for each input cargo, the three closest industries that produce it, plus the three closest warehouses that have it in stock.
- Consumers: for each cargo the building sends out, the three closest industries and towns that use it.
- The arrow button on a row draws one cargo-flow arrow on the map and moves the camera so both ends are in view. The arrow is animated if that flow already runs, and faint if it doesn't yet. Arrows to or from a warehouse are always bright and static, because the game doesn't record which flows go through a warehouse.
- Each cargo starts collapsed and shows the distance to its nearest match. Click it to expand.
- The locate button moves the camera to a building, and clicking its name opens that building's window.

Distances are measured in a straight line. Lists are worked out when the window opens. Cosmetic mod: achievements stay available, and you can add it to or remove it from existing saves.
